auto_fix.title: Orphan sweep reads .issue.assignee, which br coordination status never emits, so the roster can never match and ORPHANS never fires
auto_fix.fix: Select on `(.assessment.assignee? // .issue.assignee? // "")`, or better, the assessment field alone. Rebuild the test fixture from a captured real `br coordination status --json` claim, with assignee under .assessment. Add a harness case that fails if the field path is wrong, e.g. a fixture with the assignee only under .assessment must be REFUSED.

auto_fix.title: ORPHANS fixture puts assignee where real br never does, so the roster sweep is certified green while fail-open on every real board
auto_fix.fix: Replace the CLAIM fixture with a shape captured from a live `br coordination status --json` (issue without assignee, assessment.assignee set). Then fix coordinator.sh:121 to read `(.assessment.assignee? // .issue.assignee? // "")`. Add a guard in the test that fails if the fixture ever drifts from the live schema (e.g. assert the fixture carries schema_version br.coordination.v1 and assessment.assignee).

auto_fix.title: Roster orphan sweep reads .issue.assignee, a field br coordination status never emits, so the ORPHANS refusal can never fire on a real claim
auto_fix.fix: Select on `(.assessment.assignee? // .issue.assignee? // "")`; change coordinator.test.sh's CLAIM fixture to the real shape (assignee under .assessment, none under .issue) and add a case that captures a live `br coordination status --json` sample as the fixture so a schema drift fails the test.

auto_fix.title: Capture guard is bypassed whole by a glued shell separator (`cd /tmp; br create ...`)
auto_fix.fix: Tokenize with shlex.shlex(command, posix=True, punctuation_chars=True) and whitespace_split=True, so that ; & | && || come out as separate tokens. Or pad unquoted ; & | in newlines_to_separators() the way ( and ) are padded now. Add BLOCK cases for `cd /tmp; br create "y" -t task`, `true;br create ...`, `true&&br create ...` and `a|br create ...`.

auto_fix.title: `refined` is dropped from the readiness allowlist but never refused, so four create shapes still stamp it
auto_fix.fix: Add an explicit refusal before the readiness check that applies to every type, including None and epic: `if has_label(cmd, "refined"): print(REFINED_MESSAGE); sys.exit(2)`. Treat an absent `-t` as br's default `task` rather than 'cannot know', and keep the skip for `<`/`$` placeholders only. Extend the guard to `br label add ... refined` and `br update ... --add-label refined` (sanctioned when called from stamp-refined.sh, e.g. via an env marker the wrapper sets). Add BLOCK cases for shapes (a) to (d).

auto_fix.title: Create guard still admits `refined` at creation whenever an allowed readiness label rides alongside it
auto_fix.fix: Add an explicit refusal before the readiness check, independent of type: `if 'refined' in all_labels(cmd): refuse(REFINED_AT_CREATE)` (epics included, since stamp-refined.sh is the sole writer for them too). Add test rows for `refined,unrefined`, repeated `-l ... -l refined`, and `-t epic -l ...,refined`.

auto_fix.title: WORKER_RE is anchored to the whole comment, so every multi-line canon receipt (and any non-stamp `WORKER:` note) goes RED
auto_fix.fix: Validate only the first line of a `WORKER:` comment: `first = stripped.splitlines()[0]; if first.startswith('WORKER: model=') and not WORKER_RE.match(first)` (or match with re.M on line 1). Decide in beads-standards whether `WORKER:` is reserved for the stamp; if so, say so there and keep the rule, if not, key the check on `WORKER: model=`. Add a multi-line canon-receipt GREEN case to 35-board-integrity.test.sh.

auto_fix.title: Staged-lane WORKER rule re-judges every historical comment on a touched id, contradicting the check's own forward-only doctrine (docstring left stale)
auto_fix.fix: Scope rule 5 to comments NEW in this commit: diff the comment ids of the staged row against the HEAD row (the check already loads both blobs for changed_ids) and validate only the added ones. Update the docstring's 'Closed beads are NEVER scanned' paragraph to name which rules are status-agnostic (4) and which are delta-scoped (5).

auto_fix.title: Orphan-sweep roster has no producer: workers mint `ac-<ts>-$$` and never hand their ACTOR back
auto_fix.fix: Close the producer side: worker.md §9 must return `ACTOR: <value>` as a required hand-back line (and SKILL.md Phase 1/2 must collect it from the hand-back, not from a tool response the conductor never sees); or have coordinator.sh derive the roster from this run's `CLAIM:` comments. Add a coordinator.test case where the assignee is an `ac-<ts>-<pid>` identity to prove the roster path end-to-end.

auto_fix.title: An empty --actor value passes the empty-roster guard and then matches every in_progress claim, so the sweep flags live claims it does not own
auto_fix.fix: Reject empty or whitespace-only --actor values as NOT-GATED at parse time (`[ -n "${2:-}" ] || { echo 'NOT-GATED: --actor requires a non-empty name' >&2; exit 2; }`). Add a harness case for `--actor ""`.

auto_fix.title: The WORKER: rule re-checks every historical comment on any changed bead, so touching a bead with an old stamp that br cannot edit makes the ledger commit permanently RED
auto_fix.fix: Scope the rule to comments added by this commit: diff the comment ids or texts of head_map[rid] against staged_map[rid] and check only the new ones. Add a test that touches a HEAD bead carrying an old four-field stamp (GREEN) and one that adds a malformed stamp to an existing bead (RED).

auto_fix.title: Nothing tests the bead's core contract, exact match and never a prefix
auto_fix.fix: Add a prefix-collision case: claim assignee 'CaveBear' (or 'swarm-RUNA-Cave') with `--actor Cave` must exit 0. Add the reverse too: assignee 'Cave' with `--actor CaveBear` must exit 0.

auto_fix.title: The REPEATABLE --actor roster is never exercised with more than one actor
auto_fix.fix: Add a case with a claim assigned to 'Cave', run as `--actor Cave --actor Other`. It must be refused (rc 1, names ac-1). Also add `--actor Other --actor Cave` so position does not matter.

auto_fix.title: WORKER-grammar rule's changed-id scoping is unguarded: an untouched malformed receipt is never in any fixture
auto_fix.fix: Add a staged-lane case: commit WORKER_BAD at HEAD via git_board, then stage an unrelated OPEN_TAGGED change. Expect rc 0. This mirrors the existing 'pre-existing malformed bead untouched by this commit' case for the origin/probe rules.

auto_fix.title: Check 35 WORKER rule relitigates the past: every legacy receipt on a touched bead goes RED, contradicting the no-backfill ruling
auto_fix.fix: Diff comments by comment id against HEAD's row and check only the newly added ones. Match the grammar on the first line only (`WORKER_RE.match(stripped.splitlines()[0])`) or document that a receipt must be single-line. Add a test with a touched legacy bead that carries an old-grammar receipt, expected GREEN, and one with a multi-line canon receipt.

auto_fix.title: Empty-roster refusal counts argv slots, not names: `--actor ""` passes and the sweep selects nothing
auto_fix.fix: In the arg loop, refuse an empty or missing value: `--actor) [ -n "${2:-}" ] || { echo 'NOT-GATED: --actor needs a non-empty name' >&2; exit 2; }; ACTORS+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;` and apply the same guard to --run and --root. Optionally list in_progress claims whose assignee is not on the roster as an advisory line, so an incomplete roster is visible and not silent.

auto_fix.title: WORKER: rule scans every historic comment on a changed bead, so 98 legacy receipts wedge any touch of 120 closed beads
auto_fix.fix: Judge only comments this commit adds. Diff the changed row's comment ids or texts against the HEAD row (head_map[rid].comments) and apply WORKER_RE to new comments only. Alternatively gate on comment created_at >= the grammar cutover date, mirroring CUTOVER. Add a test: a HEAD row with a legacy receipt plus a staged new non-WORKER comment must stay GREEN.

auto_fix.title: `tree=` field is filled with the consumer repo's commit SHA yet canonised as the tree SHA and the skills-eval axis
auto_fix.fix: Either rename the field to what it holds (`commit=`) and drop the skills-eval claim, or keep a doctrine axis explicitly (e.g. `skills=$(git -C <agent-compounds> rev-parse --short HEAD)`) and update WORKER_RE, worker.md:243, and the canon together.

auto_fix.title: The capture guard still admits `refined` at create when a readiness label sits beside it, so the commit's 'close the last bypass' claim is false
auto_fix.fix: Add an explicit refusal when `refined` appears in all_labels(cmd) on any `br create`, whatever other labels are present. Add BLOCK cases for `unrefined,refined` and for a separate `-l refined` flag.

auto_fix.title: A trailing --actor with no value makes coordinator.sh loop forever
auto_fix.fix: Guard every valued flag, e.g. `--actor) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { echo 'NOT-GATED: --actor needs a value' >&2; exit 2; }; ACTORS+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;`, and apply the same guard to --run and --root.

auto_fix.title: Canon says tree= is 'the tree SHA' and the skills-eval before/after axis; the producer writes the consumer repo's short commit SHA
auto_fix.fix: Reword to `tree=<short commit SHA of the working repo at close>` and drop the skills-eval-axis claim, or make the producer stamp the agent-compounds SHA (`git -C "$(dirname "$(readlink -f skills/ac-implement)")" rev-parse --short HEAD`) and say so.

auto_fix.title: 'Empty roster is NOT-GATED unconditionally' is bypassed by --actor "", which selects every unassigned-looking claim; a trailing --actor hangs forever
auto_fix.fix: In the --actor arm: `[ -n "${2:-}" ] || { echo "NOT-GATED: --actor needs a non-empty name" >&2; exit 2; }` before the append (the same guard fixes the shift-2 hang for this flag; apply it to --run/--root too). Add coordinator.test.sh cases for `--actor ""` and a trailing `--actor`, both expected rc 2.

deferred.title: Off-canon status rule is board-wide in the staged lane: one agent's `br update --status pinned` blocks every other agent's ledger commit
deferred.fix: Scope rule 4 like rules 3 and 5: in the staged lane, fire only for rid in changed_ids, and keep the whole-board sweep for the full run. Or refuse off-canon statuses where they are written (a PreToolUse leg on `br update --status` outside STATUS_CANON), so the violation is charged to the agent that causes it.

deferred.title: `blocked` status is canonised as 'needs a human' but no human surface reads it — parked beads sink silently
deferred.fix: Give the state one reader: either make worker.md's park step also add `human-gate` (and a Gate-reason:) so the existing docket owns it, or make board-scan.md's docket population `human-gate OR status==blocked` and add a `status=blocked` row to the categorization table. Pick one and state it in the canon row.

deferred.title: Second copies of the status canon left drifting after `blocked` was admitted
deferred.fix: Update bead-conventions.md:54 to point at the `blocked` status (or to SKILL.md § Status & priority canon rather than restating); drop `/done` from board-scan.md:66; replace the on_docket comment with a pointer only, or delete it.

deferred.title: WORKER_RE requires the whole comment to be one line, so a canon stamp followed by a narrative is refused
deferred.fix: Match the grammar against the first line only (`stripped.splitlines()[0]`). Add a GREEN fixture with a canon first line plus a narrative body.

deferred.title: WORKER fixtures don't match the real board's receipt shapes (trailing newline, spaced model ids)
deferred.fix: Give WORKER_GOOD the real trailing '\n'. Add a fixture using a live legacy receipt ('model=Claude Sonnet 5 ...') with the verdict decided explicitly (RED per the canon's <model-id>, or the regex widened), so the rule's behaviour on real history is pinned instead of accidental.

deferred.title: qa-blocker bullet now says 'use the blocked status' to mark a bead blocked, contradicting the canon's own blocks-edge rule and the blocked row's semantics
deferred.fix: Restore 'To mark a single bead waiting on other work, use a `blocks` dependency — never this label' and drop only the stale parenthetical, as ac-4y7l.1 specified.

deferred.title: Check 35 docstring still says closed beads are NEVER scanned and describes rule 4 as 'either status', but rules 4 and 5 now scan closed rows
deferred.fix: Line 39 -> 'Closed beads are never scanned for the origin/probe rules (3)'. Line 31 -> 'ANY row, whatever its status, both lanes'. Add the WORKER receipt to the commit-scoped rule list at line 47.
